QS_RIVAL_PARTY._comment: Race-clock encounter for The Rival Company. TurnsToDecay mirrors QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_START's RoundsToExpire: if the player has not completed the bounty (DecayConditions' HAS_USER_STAT flag) before it decays, StartQuest fires QS_RIVAL_COMPANY_RIVAL_WINS, which Conflicts-closes the player's quest. SpawnConditions MAX_INSTANCE:1 keeps only one rival party active per run.
